summary: preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated payload math_init.js
details: package.json declares preinstall: `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is itself obfuscated (obfuscator.io-style `_0x` hex identifiers, per-function string-map objects wrapping fs/https/execFileSync). On install it downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it via execFileSync against a locally-shipped 727KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js`. The payload uses obfuscator.io transforms (shuffled string array via a rotator function, hex-named identifiers, control-flow flattening) and is named to imply math functionality, but the package's advertised code (dist/index-node18.mjs) is a one-line `Hello ${name}!` template. Bun is pulled in specifically to run this bundled payload outside Node's inspection surface at every `npm install` with the installer's privileges. The payload's actual behavior is deliberately hidden from review.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
